evals.expected_output: Runs mobile+desktop lighthouse against the URL, summarizes the JSON reports with the bundled script (not raw Read), diagnoses at least the LCP/unused-JS findings against actual source files in this repo (cites file:line), writes lighthouse-fix-report-plan.md at repo root following the template, and asks whether to fix now or later before editing any source.
